verses.original: Ταύτην ἤδη ἀγαπητοί δευτέραν ὑμῖν γράφω ἐπιστολήν ἐν αἷς διεγείρω ὑμῶν ἐν ὑπομνήσει τὴν εἰλικρινῆ διάνοιαν
verses.transliteration: Tautēn ēdē agapētoi deuteran hymin graphō epistolēn en hais diegeirō hymōn en hypomnēsei tēn eilikrinē dianoian
verses.literal: Beloved this is now my second letter . . . to you Both of them are reminders to stir you to wholesome thinking
verses.literalPt: Esta é já, amados, a segunda carta que vos escrevo; em ambas as quais desperto, com recordações, o vosso ânimo sincero,

verses.original: μνησθῆναι τῶν προειρημένων ῥημάτων ὑπὸ τῶν ἁγίων προφητῶν καὶ τῆς τῶν ἀποστόλων ὑμῶν ἐντολῆς τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ Σωτῆρος
verses.transliteration: mnēsthēnai tōn proeirēmenōn rhēmatōn hypo tōn hagiōn prophētōn kai tēs tōn apostolōn hymōn entolēs tou Kyriou kai Sōtēros
verses.literal: by recalling what was foretold by the holy prophets and commanded by our Lord and Savior through your apostles
verses.literalPt: para que vos lembreis das palavras que dantes foram ditas pelos santos profetas e do mandamento que o Senhor e Salvador vos deu pelos vossos apóstolos,

verses.original: τοῦτο πρῶτον γινώσκοντες ὅτι ἐλεύσονται ἐπ’ ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἐν ἐμπαιγμονῇ ἐμπαῖκται κατὰ τὰς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας αὐτῶν πορευόμενοι
verses.transliteration: touto prōton ginōskontes hoti eleusontai ep’ eschatōn tōn hēmerōn en empaigmonē empaiktai kata tas idias epithymias autōn poreuomenoi
verses.literal: Most importantly you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come scoffing and following their own evil desires
verses.literalPt: sabendo, primeiro, isto, que nos últimos dias, virão escarnecedores com zombarias, andando segundo as suas cobiças

verses.original: καὶ λέγοντες Ποῦ ἐστιν ἡ ἐπαγγελία τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ ἀφ’ ἧς γὰρ οἱ πατέρες ἐκοιμήθησαν πάντα οὕτως διαμένει ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως
verses.transliteration: kai legontes Pou estin hē epangelia tēs parousias autou aph’ hēs gar hoi pateres ekoimēthēsan panta houtōs diamenei ap’ archēs ktiseōs
verses.literal: Where is the promise of His coming they will ask Ever since our fathers fell asleep everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation
verses.literalPt: e dizendo: Onde está a promessa da sua vinda? Porque, desde que os pais dormiram, tudo permanece como desde o princípio da criação.

verses.original: Λανθάνει γὰρ αὐτοὺς τοῦτο θέλοντας ὅτι οὐρανοὶ ἦσαν ἔκπαλαι καὶ γῆ ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ δι’ ὕδατος συνεστῶσα τῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ λόγῳ
verses.transliteration: Lanthanei gar autous touto thelontas hoti ouranoi ēsan ekpalai kai gē ex hydatos kai di’ hydatos synestōsa tō tou Theou logō
verses.literal: But they deliberately overlook the fact that . . . long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water
verses.literalPt: Isto de propósito esquecem: que eram já dantes os céus e a terra que da água e no meio da água subsiste pela palavra de Deus.

verses.original: δι’ ὧν ὁ τότε κόσμος ὕδατι κατακλυσθεὶς ἀπώλετο
verses.transliteration: di’ hōn ho tote kosmos hydati kataklystheis apōleto
verses.literal: through which the world of that time perished in the flood . . .
verses.literalPt: Por causa dessas coisas, pereceu o mundo de então, afogado em água;

verses.original: οἱ δὲ νῦν οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἡ γῆ τῷ αὐτῷ λόγῳ τεθησαυρισμένοι εἰσὶν πυρὶ τηρούμενοι εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως καὶ ἀπωλείας τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: hoi de nyn ouranoi kai hē gē tō autō logō tethēsaurismenoi eisin pyri tēroumenoi eis hēmeran kriseōs kai apōleias tōn asebōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: And by that same word the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men
verses.literalPt: mas os céus que agora existem e a terra, pela mesma palavra, se guardam para o fogo, reservados até o Dia do Juízo e da perdição dos homens ímpios.

verses.original: Ἓν δὲ τοῦτο μὴ λανθανέτω ὑμᾶς ἀγαπητοί ὅτι μία ἡμέρα παρὰ Κυρίῳ ὡς χίλια ἔτη καὶ χίλια ἔτη ὡς ἡμέρα μία
verses.transliteration: Hen de touto mē lanthanetō hymas agapētoi hoti mia hēmera para Kyriō hōs chilia etē kai chilia etē hōs hēmera mia
verses.literal: Beloved do not let this one thing escape your notice . . . With the Lord a day is like a thousand years and a thousand years are like a day
verses.literalPt: Porém, amados, somente disto não vos deveis esquecer: de que um dia diante do Senhor é como mil anos, e mil anos, como um dia.

verses.original: οὐ βραδύνει Κύριος τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ὥς τινες βραδύτητα ἡγοῦνται ἀλλὰ μακροθυμεῖ εἰς ὑμᾶς μὴ βουλόμενός τινας ἀπολέσθαι ἀλλὰ πάντας εἰς μετάνοιαν χωρῆσαι
verses.transliteration: ou bradynei Kyrios tēs epangelias hōs tines bradytēta hēgountai alla makrothymei eis hymas mē boulomenos tinas apolesthai alla pantas eis metanoian chōrēsai
verses.literal: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness but is patient with you not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance
verses.literalPt: Não retarda o Senhor a sua promessa, como alguns entendem; mas ele é longânimo para convosco, não querendo que alguns pereçam, mas que todos venham ao arrependimento.

verses.original: Ἥξει δὲ ἡμέρα Κυρίου ὡς κλέπτης ἐν ᾗ οἱ οὐρανοὶ ῥοιζηδὸν παρελεύσονται στοιχεῖα δὲ καυσούμενα λυθήσεται καὶ γῆ καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔργα οὐχ εὑρεθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Hēxei de hēmera Kyriou hōs kleptēs en hē hoi ouranoi rhoizēdon pareleusontai stoicheia de kausoumena lythēsetai kai gē kai ta en autē erga ouch heurethēsetai
verses.literal: But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief - The heavens will disappear with a roar the elements will be destroyed by fire and the earth and its works will be laid bare
verses.literalPt: Mas virá como ladrão o Dia do Senhor, em que os céus passarão com grande estrondo, os elementos, com o calor, se dissolverão, e a terra e as obras que nela há serão descobertas.

verses.original: Τούτων οὕτως πάντων λυομένων ποταποὺς δεῖ ὑπάρχειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ἁγίαις ἀναστροφαῖς καὶ εὐσεβείαις
verses.transliteration: Toutōn houtōs pantōn lyomenōn potapous dei hyparchein hymas en hagiais anastrophais kai eusebeiais
verses.literal: Since everything . . . will be destroyed in this way what kind of people ought you to be You ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness
verses.literalPt: Uma vez que todas essas coisas hão de ser assim dissolvidas, quais vos convém ser em santo procedimento e piedade,

verses.original: προσδοκῶντας καὶ σπεύδοντας τὴν παρουσίαν τῆς τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμέρας δι’ ἣν οὐρανοὶ πυρούμενοι λυθήσονται καὶ στοιχεῖα καυσούμενα τήκεται
verses.transliteration: prosdokōntas kai speudontas tēn parousian tēs tou Theou hēmeras di’ hēn ouranoi pyroumenoi lythēsontai kai stoicheia kausoumena tēketai
verses.literal: as you anticipate and hasten the coming of the day of God when the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt in the heat
verses.literalPt: esperando e desejando ardentemente a vinda do Dia de Deus, pelo qual os céus, ardendo, se dissolverão, e os elementos, com o calor, se fundirão?

verses.original: καινοὺς δὲ οὐρανοὺς καὶ γῆν καινὴν κατὰ τὸ ἐπάγγελμα αὐτοῦ προσδοκῶμεν ἐν οἷς δικαιοσύνη κατοικεῖ
verses.transliteration: kainous de ouranous kai gēn kainēn kata to epangelma autou prosdokōmen en hois dikaiosynē katoikei
verses.literal: But in keeping with God’s promise we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth where righteousness dwells
verses.literalPt: Mas nós, segundo a sua promessa, esperamos novos céus e uma nova terra, nos quais habita a justiça.

verses.original: Διό ἀγαπητοί ταῦτα προσδοκῶντες σπουδάσατε ἄσπιλοι καὶ ἀμώμητοι αὐτῷ εὑρεθῆναι ἐν εἰρήνῃ
verses.transliteration: Dio agapētoi tauta prosdokōntes spoudasate aspiloi kai amōmētoi autō heurethēnai en eirēnē
verses.literal: Therefore beloved as you anticipate these things make every effort to be found at peace spotless and blameless in His sight
verses.literalPt: Por isso, amados, visto que estais esperando essas coisas, procurai diligentemente que por ele sejais achados imaculados e irrepreensíveis, em paz;

verses.original: Καὶ τὴν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν μακροθυμίαν σωτηρίαν ἡγεῖσθε καθὼς καὶ ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἡμῶν ἀδελφὸς Παῦλος κατὰ τὴν δοθεῖσαν αὐτῷ σοφίαν ἔγραψεν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Kai tēn tou Kyriou hēmōn makrothymian sōtērian hēgeisthe kathōs kai ho agapētos hēmōn adelphos Paulos kata tēn dotheisan autō sophian egrapsen hymin
verses.literal: Consider also that our Lord’s patience brings salvation just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom God gave him . . .
verses.literalPt: e tende por salvação a longanimidade de nosso Senhor, como o nosso amado irmão Paulo vos escreveu, segundo a sabedoria que lhe foi dada,

verses.original: ὡς καὶ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἐπιστολαῖς λαλῶν ἐν αὐταῖς περὶ τούτων ἐν αἷς ἐστιν δυσνόητά τινα ἃ οἱ ἀμαθεῖς καὶ ἀστήρικτοι στρεβλοῦσιν ὡς καὶ τὰς λοιπὰς γραφὰς πρὸς τὴν ἰδίαν αὐτῶν ἀπώλειαν
verses.transliteration: hōs kai en pasais tais epistolais lalōn en autais peri toutōn en hais estin dysnoēta tina ha hoi amatheis kai astēriktoi streblousin hōs kai tas loipas graphas pros tēn idian autōn apōleian
verses.literal: He writes this way . . . in all his letters speaking in them about such matters Some parts of his letters are hard to understand which ignorant and unstable people distort as they do the rest of the Scriptures to their own destruction
verses.literalPt: como faz também em todas as suas epístolas, nelas falando disso, nas quais há algumas coisas difíceis de entender, que os indoutos e inconstantes torcem, como o fazem também com as demais Escrituras, para a sua perdição.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς οὖν ἀγαπητοί προγινώσκοντες φυλάσσεσθε ἵνα μὴ τῇ τῶν ἀθέσμων πλάνῃ συναπαχθέντες ἐκπέσητε τοῦ ἰδίου στηριγμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hymeis oun agapētoi proginōskontes phylassesthe hina mē tē tōn athesmōn planē synapachthentes ekpesēte tou idiou stērigmou
verses.literal: Therefore beloved since you already know these things be on your guard so that you will not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your secure standing
verses.literalPt: Vós, portanto, amados, sabendo isso de antemão, acautelai-vos, para que não suceda que, levados pelo erro dos insubordinados, caiais da vossa firmeza;

verses.original: αὐξάνετε δὲ ἐν χάριτι καὶ γνώσει τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ Σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ νῦν καὶ εἰς ἡμέραν αἰῶνος Ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: auxanete de en chariti kai gnōsei tou Kyriou hēmōn kai Sōtēros Iēsou Christou autō hē doxa kai nyn kai eis hēmeran aiōnos Amēn
verses.literal: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity Amen
verses.literalPt: mas crescei na graça e no conhecimento de nosso Senhor e Salvador Jesus Cristo. A ele seja dada a glória, tanto agora como até o dia da eternidade.
